name: Drug Ouji to Matori Hime
original_name: ドラッグ王子とマトリ姫
source: The protagonist is recruted by the police because of her background in pharmacy and specially, her blood's surprising ability to supress the effect of narcotic drugs. However, this ability makes her specially targeted by people with malicious intents, so she's granted a bodyguard.
